title: File:HINTS test.jpg
author: von Martial R, Leinweber C, Hubert N, Rambold H, Haberl RL, Hubert, and Müller-Barna P
description: "Performance of the three-step HINTS test battery: (HI) head impulse test, (N) nystagmus detection and (TS) test of skew. Nystagmus detection is performed in primary gaze position with and without fixation as well as looking about 20◦–30◦ to the right and to the left."
